title: 2026 Midterm Primaries: Trump Campaigns Against 7-Term Rep. Massie in Most Expensive House Primary Ever
detail: Voters in six states — Kentucky, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Alabama, Oregon, and Idaho — cast ballots in 2026 midterm primaries. The marquee race is Kentucky's 6th District, where 7-term Republican Rep. Thomas Massie faces Trump-backed challenger Jerome Gallrein in what has become the most expensive House primary in US history. President Trump actively campaigned against the incumbent Massie, a frequent thorn in the House GOP caucus known for his libertarian-leaning independence.
